validation_source: Validation relayed by Idris in the project conversation.

functional_safety_rules.description: A missing value is never interpreted as zero or as a negative assay result.
An unvalidated rule cannot produce a favorable automated output.
Source results are preserved before any longitudinal description.
A simplified-review candidate still requires explicit human confirmation.

validated_medical_rules.description: Age strictly above 65 contributes one point; otherwise it contributes zero.
Zero, one, or multiple pregnancies contribute zero, one, or two points.
Zero, one, multiple, or explicitly regular transfusions contribute zero, one, two, or three points.
Scores 0, 1, 2-4, 5, and 6 map to minimal, moderate, medium, high, and very high.
A missing required datum produces an uncertain category.
A non-minimal profile or an evolving or fluctuating history requires biological review.
A minimal profile with a validated negative constant history is a simplified-review candidate and still requires human confirmation.
